name: Song of Fire and Thunder
description: When above {{melee_ap}} AP, your melee attacks are imbued in flame, dealing more damage. If below 25% max hp, your high-damaging melee attacks have a chance to inflict scorch (10s CD)When above {{kido_ap}} AP, your kido attacks are inflict thunder, dealing more stun. If below 25% max hp, your high-damaging kido attacks have a chance to inflict electroshock ({{kido_cd}}s CD)

name: Aura Of Terror
description: Manual spiritual pressure is replaced with an AOE attack that inflicts a terrifying status effect on enemies hit and deal {{hp_dmg}} max HP damage ({{cd}}s CD)

name: Adrenaline Junkie
description:
Gain 1% output on hit up to 107% (not including multi hit techniques). If you do not get hit/hit an enemy for 30 seconds, automatically return to 100%.
 Lose 1% output when getting hit, down to 10%

name: Await The Opening
description:
Your parries now posture break.
 Your parries are worth {{parry_dmg}} as much posture damage

name: Blazing Spirit
description:
Parrying a basic melee attack ignites your blade with spirit flames ({{cd}}s CD, +{{dmg_buff}} damage)
 Basic Melee attacks not ignited by flame deal reduced damage (-{{dmg_debuff}}% damage)

name: Blademaster
description: Your bladed basic attacks inflict deep gash stacks on your opponent. Your bladed basic attacks deal {{dmg_reduction}} less damage. Upon reaching {{deep_gash_amount}} deep gash stacks, deal {{deep_gash_dmg}}% of all the damage you would have done normally.

name: Curtain Call
description:
As long as your reiatsu is at {{rei_amount}}, your basic attacks have percent lifesteal 
 You no longer passively regenerate reiatsu

name: Flawless Swordsman
description:
Dealing damage without being hit will build 'Perfection', whilst Perfection is building gain up to a {{dmg_buff}} damage buff towards enemies, at half stacks or more all damage is fire damage.
Suffering a hit or leaving combat will extinguish your flame of ambition, losing all stacks. Leaving a cooldown of 10s before your next attempt.

name: Haze of Death
description: Your critical attack applies Cursed ({{cd}}s CD)

name: Heavenly Restriction
description:
Your physical attacks are up to {{dmg_buff}} more potent, scaling with level
 You have {{aura_gain}} more aura gain, scaling with level
 You gain {{max_ap}} more max AP and {{shunpo_buff}} more shunpo speed and stamina. You gain up to {{move_speed}} more movement speed
 You slightly gain melee defense and kido defense
 Your aura is on a shorter cooldown and you gain more output in aura
 Your critical attacks now auto-execute. You do more damage towards riposte and you cannot be sensed
 You cannot use abilities to any capacity
 (Does not fully stack with Warrior's Spirit)

name: Kill Confirmed
description:
Knocking an opponent will cause them to succumb to your spiritual pressure and cause their head to blow off 
Blowing their head off will reduce your output by {{debuff}} (Scaling with nearby enemies) temporarily

name: Last Man Standing
description:
If an ally is to be knocked within 90 meters of you, siphon the enemies HP pack and gain a percent of it yourself 
Your regeneration from all sources is cut in half

name: Monster Slayer
description:
For every nearby NPC enemy gain a stack of 'Slayer', up to 10 stacks 
 For every stack of 'Slayer' gain {{monster_dmg}}% more Monster Damage, increasing up to 3.5 times 
 While you have 'Slayer' stacks: at 3 stacks gain weaker Curtain Call, at 4 stacks become immune to movement slow, and at 6 stacks your Curtain Call strengthens 
 When you're put in combat by a player, all 'Slayer' stacks are rendered invalid

name: Quick Grit
description: Landing 3 different non-barrage attacks on the same person within {{window}}s smites the opponent, granting a {{dmg_buff}} damage buff on the most recent attack ({{cooldown}}s CD)

name: Raid Boss
description:
Your aura cooldown is shortened
 For every nearby PLAYER enemy gain a stack of battle fever, for every nearby PLAYER ally lose a stack of battle fever, up to 10 stacks
 For every stack of battle fever gain {{aura_buildup}} more aura buildup. While your Aura is active, this instead boosts your Spiritual Pressure's power level, both increasing up to 3.5 times
 While your Aura is active: at 3 stacks gain weaker Curtain Call, at 4 stacks become immune to movement slow, at 6 stacks your Curtain Call strengthens, finally at 7 stacks your m1s periodically proc Perfect Flash
 When your battle fever is empty and allies are nearby take 10% more damage

name: Ruler's Gaze
description:
Performing a guard break activates "Geass".
Whilst "Geass" is active, issue a command to the opponent to halt, allowing for a longer follow up. "Geass" cannot be used on the same target twice, and has a cooldown. Being in "Aura" ignores the first restriction.

name: Shonen Syndrome
description:
Yell out the move you are about to use 
 Upgrades the move by {{levels}} levels (Does not work past level 6)
 {{cd}} second cooldown between upgrades

name: Struggler's Spirit
description:
Landing three basic attacks when below {{hp_percent}} HP will balster your strength ({{cd}}s CD)
 You take {{dmg_reduction}} less damage when your health is below 25%

name: Soul Snatcher
description:
Landing any kido ability on a opponent who is less than {{hp_percent}} HP will activate Soul Snatcher
 Enemies with Soul Snatcher activated on them will immediately be knocked after a short delay

name: The Incapable
description:
Your innate base output is up to {{base}} depending on level, this goes up to {{max_base}} based on missing HP
 Gain access to a reliquary attached to your waist, this is the source of your power. It glows based on missing HP
 You can no longer use transformations or racial abilities, and effects of hollow traits are disabled
 You can not access your racial progression boss fights

name: Undying Soul
description:
Unleash a second wind when defeated, become ungrabbable in this state
 Your death is certain when your health runs out

name: Ultimate Sacrifice
description:
Break your current limits and go beyond when popping Aura 
 Your rage is born from deep within your heart. Nothing can stop it (Uncancellable Aura)
 You build aura more slowly. The ultimate sacrifice... has the ultimate price

name: Warrior's Spirit
description:
{{dmg_buff}} melee damage increase on basic attacks
 You can no longer Flash Step nor Manual Rushdown

name: You're In My Range
description:
{{gap_defense}} defense towards gap-close abilities
 Your next basic attack or critical is empowered after being attacked by a gap-close ability (45s CD)

name: Jack-o-Lantern
description:
Maiming a player forces them to wear a pumpkin head. The pumpkin head remains for 1 minute until it explode. For each kill, you gain a jack-o'-lantern (max 3) that hovers behind you. When taking a lethal blow you consume a jack-o'-lantern and heal.
 You now grip players 2.5x slower
 You now maim enemies 1.25x slower

name: Backline Buster
description: Hitting an opponent then hitting a different opponent shortly after procs Perfect Flash ({{cd}}s CD)

name: No Time To Spare
description: Once put into combat, gain the effecs of light feet until you are hit.

name: Close and Personal
description:
{{dmg_buff}} weapon/hakuda damage
 {{dmg_debuff}} damage vulnerability

name: Deep Hatred
description: When posture broken or grabbed, enter a fit of rage for {{duration}}s, boosting your output by 10% (30s CD)

name: Factotum's Spirit
description:
{{xp_gain}} increased EXP gain
 {{xp_loss}} increased EXP loss

name: Frostwalker
description:
Dealing a high-damage kido blow will embue you in frost, this effect lasts {{frost_duration}}s or until consumed
 While frosted your next basic attack will freeze your opponent (25s CD) 
 While frosted, lose {{speed_debuff}} movespeed

name: Frugal
description:
You lose 80% less cash from dying to players
 You don't gain cash from players

name: Golem
description:
Taking {{dmg_amount}}+ base damage withing 2.5s will activate rock armor for {{duration}}s (45s CD)
 While rock-armored, gain {{dmg_resist}} damage resistence

name: Heat Burst
description:
Replaces your Aura with Heat
 When Heat activates, automatically heal {{heal}} of your maximum health and gain max AP
 Lose access to Aura-based theme buff

name: Indomitable Spirit
description:
Gain {{hp}} of your health back from winning clashes
 Lose {{hp_loss}} of your health upon losing clashes

name: Lizard's Spirit
description: When your health reaches below {{hp_amount}}, heal {{heal}} (9m CD)

name: Marshland King
description:
Build aura {{buildup}} faster, and unleash a menacing laugh when popping it
 Your aura is {{duration}} shorter and the buffs are {{aura_nerf}} weaker

name: Merchant's Blessing
description: Gain {{token_gain}} more soul tokens from all gameplay sources

name: Mysterious Stranger (Her)
description: The mysterious stranger has a {{chance}} chance to aid you when dealing ranged kido damage (30s CD)

name: Mysterious Stranger (Him)
description: The mysterious stranger has a {{chance}} chance to aid you when dealing physical damage (30s CD)

name: Nowhere to Hide
description:
Striking an opponent below {{player_hp}} HP while you are above 50% HP will cause them to be revealed for 5s 
 Deal {{dmg_buff}} more damage to those who are revealed

name: Overtime Hours
description:
During a mission, if the clock runs down below 75% of the starting time you start running off overtime 
 During overtime, gain 6.5% output and continue to gain it for every invader that joins

name: Perfect Flash
description: Landing a melee Basic/Critical attack out of combat deals {{dmg_buff}} dmg, this also applies to full-hp opponents (60s CD)

name: Presence of Mind
description: You have an increased {{haste}} ability haste when below {{hp_amount}}% of your maximum HP

name: Poison Touch
description: Your critical attack applies poison

name: Ranged Warrior
description:
{{dmg_buff}} kido/ranged damage 
 {{dmg_debuff}} damage vulnerability

name: Reality Warper
description: 5% chance to spawn a purple portal on player kill

name: Side Character
description:
Deal {{dmg_buff}}% more damage to NPCs 
 Take {{dmg_taken}} more damage from players

name: Silent Shadows
description: Your visible aura is reduced by 60%

name: Superiority Complex
description:
Blade-catching an opponent will cause you to mock them, increasing aura gain on the blade catch ({{cd}}s CD)
 Mocked opponents instantly lose 0.2x AP and take 15% increased damage for a short duration

name: Surgeon's Spirit
description:
All heals towards you are increased by {{heal_buff}} 
 You no longer receive HP packs from knocking players

name: Swarm
description: Landing your critical attack will spawn {{spawn_amount}} friendly Dragonfly Hollow

name: Train Conductor
description:
Steal a mission ticket when killing an enemy player who has one
 Mission ticket cap increased by one
 Dying will cause you to lose 2 mission tickets

name: Tools of the Trade
description: You have absolute mastery over your weaponry, your heavy attack is never red, gain riposte on the attack anyway (Does not work for heavy attacks that are never red to begin with)

name: Tooth & Nail
description: If an attack is about to kill you, lose all of your health down to {{health_back}} instead of dying

name: Vice It
description: Blade-catching the opponent won't restore posture, however you kick the enemy away (75s CD)

name: Wraith's Spirit
description:
Getting hit by {{hit_amount}} different attacks in quick succession will cause you to turn into a invincible wraith momentarily
 You take {{melee_damage}} more damage from melee attacks

name: Dracula's Fangs
description:
Grips now give you {{grip_heal}} more hp back
 When dealing heavy damage or using your crit you have a 50% chance to proc bleed damage
 This will turn you into a.. VAMPIRE!!

name: Dead Man Walking
description:
Taking heavy amounts of damage within a short timeframe will now cause you to lose skin.. slowly turning you into a skeleton.
 For each limb lost, take {{dmg_debuff}} more damage, but also gain {{move_speed}} movement speed, up to five limbs lost. ({{cd}}s CD)

name: Witches Brew
description:
Popping aura now makes you consume a potion of poison allowing you to proc poison on all attacks when in aura.
 Aura gain is increased by {{aura_gain}}

name: At the Ready
description: Gain permanent {{haste_buff}} ability haste when invaded

name: Battle Hardened
description: You visually bleed on hits at lower health

name: Critical Blows
description: {{dmg_buff}} increased critical attack damage

name: Defensive Regen
description:
You regenerate {{rei_regen}} more reiatsu from parries
 Your base reiatsu regeneration is reduced by {{base_regen}}

name: Domination
description: Max AP is increased by {{ap_buff}}

name: Fortified Fighter
description: Gain {{defense_buff}} defense when posture broken

name: Flashmaster
description: {{shunpo_stam}} shunpo stamina

name: Giant Fighter
description:
{{dmg_buff}} more damage against Bosses
 2.5% less damage against non-boss NPCs

name: Hard Headed
description: Gain immunity to concussion

name: Head Hunter
description: Deal {{dmg_buff}} more damage towards players with active transformation/shikai if you have neither

name: Prey Turned Predator
description: If someone invades you while you are on a mission, they get combat logged

name: Resourceful Spirit
description: Your aerial launcher is counted as a critical attack, dealing slightly more damage and applying all critical attack effects

name: Trouble in Paradise
description: Deal 10% more damage when fighting in a Homeworld
